summary: Tested the 5-plan ladder (Basic $50 / Starter $75 / Pro $100 / Business $120 / Enterprise $399). Backend: 10/10 pytest pass and 46/46 node checks pass (bot config, cp_8 in 5 languages, renewalPrice and priceOnPlan). Public catalog order, prices, minutes, recommended=pro, enterprise.price=399, extraNumber.limits.standard=8 and the Starter webFeatures set are all correct. Upgrade quotes work: Basic->Starter newPrice 75, Basic->Pro newPrice 100; locked Pro $75 -> Business newPrice 120 with charge 95 and no negative surcharge. Confirming Basic->Starter saved plan=standard and planPrice=75. Lower plan gives 400 invalid_plan. The price-lock mark exists and all 4 existing pro mains carry the {pro,75} lock with one shared timestamp, so it was not re-applied. Frontend: the landing page shows 5 cards and the 'Enterprise · $399/month' card; no button text is cut off at 1920 and there is no overflow on mobile. The landing helper 'voicemail' option highlights Starter. The buy-page plan picker lists Basic, Starter, Pro and Business, and Starter can be selected. My numbers, the number page, Billing and Wallet load for the Business user. Two gaps: data-testid plan-helper-voicemail does not exist on /app/buy (the buy PlanHelper component is not rendered anywhere), and the civr.alice and civr.bob accounts do not exist in the preview DB.

minor.issue: The 25% upgrade credit uses the plan's list price (plans.pro.price=100), not the locked price. A price-locked $75 Pro customer gets a $25 credit instead of $18.75 (charge 95 instead of 101.25). Use lifecycle.listPrice(num) or num.planPrice for oldPrice.

priceLock is never cleared when the plan changes. A locked Pro number that upgrades to Business and later downgrades back to Pro renews at $75 again, because lock.plan==='pro' still matches. If the lock should only apply while the customer stays on Pro, remove priceLock on upgrade or downgrade.
NEXT_PLAN is still { starter: 'pro', pro: 'business' }, so upgrade offers send Basic users to Pro and skip Starter. phone-config.js already uses starter->standard->pro->business.

minor.endpoint: Stale plan copy in error messages
minor.issue: extras.js:117 says 'SIP needs the Pro plan or higher.' and numbers.js:232 / ring-group.js:32 say 'Voicemail needs the Pro plan or higher.' Starter now includes both.
The dev-only plan-gate and env checks still loop over ['starter','pro','business'] and skip 'standard'.

ui_bugs.issue: frontend/src/cloudivr/pages/buy/PlanHelper.js exports PlanHelper, which has the plan-helper-voicemail button, but nothing renders <PlanHelper>. Only USES is imported (by the landing helper). So data-testid plan-helper-voicemail never appears on /cloudivr/app/buy. The landing helper (landing-plan-helper-voicemail) works and picks Starter.

issues: buy-plan-picker uses md:grid-cols-3 with 4 plans, so Business sits alone on a second row. Use a 4-column grid (xl:grid-cols-4) or 2x2.
PurposePicker.js line 23 says 'Comes with the Pro and Business plans'. SIP now starts on Starter ($75), and the card's own price already shows $75.
Sip.js:40 says 'SIP needs the Pro plan or higher'. Starter now includes SIP, so this should say Starter.

action_items: Render the buy-page PlanHelper on /app/buy (plan-helper-voicemail -> standard) or update the spec. Right now it is dead code.
Use the locked price for the upgrade credit in computeUpgradeQuote.
Decide whether priceLock is dropped when a customer leaves Pro, and clear it on plan change if so.
Fix the stale 'Pro plan or higher' copy for SIP and voicemail (extras.js, numbers.js:232, ring-group.js:32, Sip.js:40) and the 'Comes with the Pro and Business plans' text in PurposePicker.
Change the buy plan-picker grid to fit 4 plans.
Recreate the civr.alice and civr.bob preview accounts, or update /app/memory/test_credentials.md. They are missing from the DB, so login gives 401 invalid_credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: computeUpgradeQuote ignores priceLock: oldPrice = plans[old].price || num.planPrice gives price-locked customers too much credit.
Only the standard and business plans have no extra SIP logins: EXTRA_SIP = { pro: 2, business: 5 } in numbers.js:734. Starter has no extra SIP logins, only the main one. Confirm this is intended.
hosted-sms PLAN_PRICE/PLAN_LIMIT include standard (150/5), the same as starter. OK.
backend/tests/test_cloudivr_pricing_iter271.py::TestCatalog asserts pro price 75. That test is now out of date (pro=100) and will fail on regression runs.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 pytest, 46/46 node checks; 5 minor issues found by code review)

test_credentials: civr.uxtest@example.com / UxTest#2026 works. civr.alice@example.com and civr.bob@example.com do NOT exist in the preview DB (webAccounts has only uxtest plus qa./test_ accounts), so the Business-user regression used uxtest.

The phoneNumbersOf and walletOf docs were deleted afterwards. One phone-upgrade transaction and the webAccount for this TEST user remain. No real numbers were bought; Telnyx search was read-only.

Buy flow: buy-purpose-voice -> buy-search-button -> buy-result-0 -> buy-plan-picker (buy-plan-starter|standard|pro|business). Checkout needs identity details for uxtest. The landing helper uses data-testid landing-plan-helper-<key>. Upgrade quote: POST /api/cloudivr-web/numbers/:phone/upgrade {plan} returns {quote}; add confirm:true to apply it.
rca of the issue: plan-helper-voicemail missing: the PlanHelper component in pages/buy/PlanHelper.js has no consumer; BuyNumber.js does not import or render it. Upgrade over-credit: computeUpgradeQuote (phone-config.js:674) prefers plans[oldPlanKey].price over the locked num.planPrice.
